description:
Read the published service area, ride requirements and local time zone before collecting ride facts. Use get_customer_policy for purchase rules, quote_ride for a price preview and prepare_offer for a new explicitly requested offer.

An optional offerKey selects a published service location; carry that selection into the following policy, quote and offer calls so the returned timeZone governs the same ride. Omit it for the default location. Locale selects wording and links, not the time zone.

Re-read before quoting: no freshness window or availability guarantee is promised. This uncached read does not consume quote admission. Correct invalid_request inputs; unavailable means the published scope could not be read.

locale.description: Use the customer's requested language for text and booking links: en by default, de for German. Preserve it on retries; pickup times stay in the provider time zone.

offerKey.description: Optional existing published provider/supplier offer key. Selects its configured service location; it is not a customer bookingKey or bookingReference and grants no booking access.
